name: Jilin Chemical Fibre Stock Co.,Ltd
summary: Jilin Chemical Fibre Stock Co.,Ltd operates as a Chinese manufacturer primarily engaged in the production and distribution of various chemical fibers. The company's comprehensive product lineup includes bio-based rayons, bamboo fibers, acrylic fibers, carbon fibers, chemical fiber pulps, and different types of yarn. Beyond its domestic operations, the firm also boasts a significant international presence, exporting its materials to approximately 30 countries and territories spread across Asia, Europe, North America (specifically the United States), and Africa. Established in 1960, Jilin, China serves as the company's headquarters.
